findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo, so Python uses wall-clock difference and ignores UTC offset, producing wrong durations across DST changes (undercharging on fall-back, overcharging on spring-forward).

judge.reason: Identifies same-tzinfo wall-clock subtraction causing wrong duration across DST at invoice.py:19.

findings.label: hit
